social_send: Publish in this group/topic. Pass exactly one of text (one message), sticker_id (one collected static sticker) or parts (the complete ordered list of 2–3 messages, including the first; each a string, {text, reply_to} or {sticker_id, reply_to}). reply_to quotes an observed message. Pass followup_id only for a proactive follow-up on a saved matter. Each message gets its own receipt.
social_wait: End this turn and wait. Choose one duration: seconds (total), until (ISO time with offset/Z) or infinite=true. purpose=messages waits for new content, then quiet; purpose=reply waits for quiet on an unfinished request and may return at once. sleeping=true sleeps. on_timeout=true wakes once if nothing arrives. until_condition says who or what you are waiting for.
social_state: action=get: role_id, role_file, mode, waiting state, proactive_paused and remaining budgets. action=read: bounded unread or recent messages of this group/topic. action=set_proactive with paused=true/false: stop or resume your own proactive contact when a member asks; replies to members are unaffected.
social_media: View images/sticker thumbnails from an observed message_id here, including quoted messages. Bounded per turn; motion uses thumbnails.
social_sticker: Manage the static sticker library; send with social_send. import_set takes set_name (addstickers link or name). view shows numbered sheets of up to 30 (unlearned_only=true by default; after annotate, view offset=0 for the next batch). annotate takes notes=[{sticker_id,note}] for stickers viewed this turn: visible text, emotion, uses. list searches notes; collect saves one from a message_id.
social_memory: Manage conversation knowledge and unfinished matters: list/record/confirm/correct/delete/clear/followup. Member facts need message_ids displayed this turn; member_ids come from their senders. Own intentions use origin=self with content, pending_question or pending_thought, and motivation. followup edits the SAME memory_id (followup_at, followup_state, state_reason). list shows remaining_attempts.
social_jargon: Look up and maintain this group's jargon silently: list/get/submit/explain/correct/disable/set_status/review. States: candidate (uncertain), understand_only (understand, never reuse), usable, disabled. submit needs human message_ids and a short term; explain quotes a human explanation verbatim; writes need expected_revision. review queues a background recheck.
social_expression: Inspect learned contextual expressions and their original message evidence in this scope. list/get/modify/disable/enable; writes require entry_id and expected_revision. Corrections and disables preserve a stable ID and block automatic relearning. Only enable explicitly reactivates an entry. This manages the library silently; it does not publish or trigger a reply.
social_activity: Private notebook for what you explore or play with in free time. list shows activities; start needs only a title (goal, motivation, next_step optional). progress saves a checkpoint; pause/resume/complete/block/abandon switch or leave an interest. Existing entries need activity_id and expected_revision. Nothing here is published and no deliverable is required.
